name: boardhop-extension
description: Azure DevOps Marketplace extension for Boardhop: connects an organization to the Boardhop relay and provisions its service-hook subscriptions.

scripts.test: esbuild test/plan.test.ts test/relay.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outdir=dist-test && node --test dist-test/plan.test.js dist-test/relay.test.js
scripts.package: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path build/
scripts.publish: npm run build && tfx extension publish --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --share-with puremedia
